fullContent:
Elakanadi Kashayam 
 Reference – Sahasrayoga Kashayaprakarana. 
 Introduction 
 Elakanadi Kashayam is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from mixture of medicinal herbs. One of the important herb is ela, which is also known with the name – cardamom, which is enriched with properties like digestive, carminative, diuretic and many more. This formulation is known to treat the problems related to respiratory problems. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ela – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Amruta – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Madhuka – Glycyrhiza glabra 
 Ginger – Zingiber officinale 
 Ambu – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Kana – Piper longum 
 Nimba – Azadirachta indica 
 Abda – Cyperus rotundus 
 Vasa – Adhatoda vasica 
 Dashamoola – known to contain ten herb roots: 
 
 
 Shyonaka – Oroxylum indicum 
 Patala – Stereospermum suaveolens 
 Bilva – Aegle marmelos 
 Agnimantha – Premna mucronata 
 Prishnaparni – Uraria picta 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Shalaparni – Desmodium gangeticum 
 Gambhari – Gmelina arborea 
 Brihati – Solanum indicum 
 Kantakari – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients in equal quantity and add in a pot which contains 8 parts of water. 
 Boil the water mixture till it is reduced up to its one fourth level and then filter it. 
 Decoction is prepared now. 
 
 Dose 
 12 to 24 ml, two times a day, before meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 As Adjuvant in Tuberculosis treatment 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Gastritis due to over dose. 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
